# Directory

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

A conference file directory with download access information.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#board-objects-400).

## CanDownload

```PPL
Directory.CanDownload() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Checks the current caller's security for directory access or downloading.

## Find

```PPL
Directory.Find(STRING text, [LONG after], [INTEGER limit]) FilePage
```

Instance function.

Searches indexed file names and stored descriptions using a case-insensitive literal substring. Optional after defaults to 0 and limit to 15 (1..100). Each call examines at most 1024 rows; continue with NextAfter while HasMore, even after an empty page. Requires current conference/list access and an initialized index; does not scan or modify files. Error.Last() reports failure.

## Flag

```PPL
Directory.Flag(STRING fileName) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Marks this directory's indexed file for the session's download batch without starting a transfer or displaying prompts. Rechecks conference/list/download rights, batch capacity and credit. TRUE means marked or already marked; FALSE reports failure through Error.Last(). Existing marks and caller tokens are preserved. DOWNLOAD remains a separate BBS step.

## HasAccess

```PPL
Directory.HasAccess() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Checks the current caller's security for directory access or downloading.
